messages:
Marie Chen: Quick sync — planning a controlled canary next Tue 08:00 PST for three runtime flags. Goal is to validate perf and stability for optimized kernels before wider rollout. Flags: `ff/flash_attn_v2=on`, `ff/spec_decoding=on`, `ff/kv_prefetch=1`.
Canary scope: start internal-only -> 5% prod (us-west2 only), node selection: `flash-ready=true`. Guardrails: auto-rollback if p99 latency +100ms OR error rate delta >0.5%. Dashboard + alerts: https://dash.internal.redwood/c/flags-canary
Need ✅ from infra (node gating), runtime (kernel compatibility), and oncall. Any blockers?

AJ Park: Do we need to opt out any customers (PII/regulatory)? Also flash_attn_v2 requires the new fused kernels on nodes built with kernel-2.x. Can we gate by node tag instead of blanket cluster rollout?

Marie Chen: Good call. We'll exclude customers with label `data_class=regulated` and gate nodes by tag. Proposed rollout policy snippet:
```
route_policy:
  regions: ["us-west2"]
  node_tag: "flash-ready"
  exclude_label: "regulated"
  audience: ["internal","acme-inc","beta-edu"]
  initial_pct: 2
  ramp_to_pct: 5
  ramp_after_min: 30
```

Samir: Quick FYI — PR #4123 updates `runtime/serve/kv_prefetch.py` to expose the prefetch param. Left one comment about the unit test. If that merges it's blocking the canary merge.

Nora Patel: For audience, prefer internal + 2 beta customers (acme-inc, beta-edu). Suggest internal-only at 2% for 30m -> if green, bump to 5%. That reduces blast radius.

Lucy: Add tracing hooks please — token-level traces and a 0.1% sampling flamegraph to capture perf regressions without noise. I'll add dashboard panels for p50/p95/p99 and token CPU.

ops-bot: Scheduled: Canary job created for 2026-05-12 08:00 PST. Job ID c-20260512-08. Notified #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: If metrics stable for 2 hours, automated policy will increase to 10% and widen to us-central1. See rollout policy `auto_scale_on_stability=true`.

DevOps: Agree with rollback triggers. Also recommend a memory guard for `kv_prefetch` on 24GB GPUs: set `kv_prefetch_limit=16MB` per worker to avoid OOMs during peak batches.

Samir: Addressed test in #4123 and pushed update. @Marie can merge once infra confirms node-tag gating exists in prod.

Marie Chen: OK — action items: @AJ to add node tag gating and verify kernels on `flash-ready` nodes; @Nora confirm beta list; @Lucy add traces/dashboards; oncall will monitor. If no objections by EOD I'll merge and run a dry-start Monday.

AJ Park: Approved. I'll push infra change to propagate `flash-ready=true` to the intended nodepool and add a label-based exclusion for regulated customers.

Nora Patel: Confirmed — acme-inc and beta-edu agreed to be in the experiment. I'll notify their eng contacts about the windows.

Lucy: :thumbsup: wiring tracing now and adding the panels. Will post link in this thread when ready.

ops-bot: Canary job c-20260512-08 will notify #eng-oncall, #product-experiments, and the owners list (@Marie Chen, @Samir, @AJ Park) on start/complete/failure.

Marie Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll publish a short runbook in this thread tomorrow. Quick rollback commands for oncall: `ff/flash_attn_v2=false; ff/spec_decoding=false; ff/kv_prefetch=0`. Keep alerts loud and we'll do an immediate rollback on any p99 spike or error-rate regression.

AJ Park: One more note — add a metric to detect token generation divergence (quality regression) with a small held-out prompt set. If quality drops >3% we'll treat it as a hard stop.

Marie Chen: Added to the guardrail list. Great catch. Closing for now, will re-open if anything else comes up before EOD.
